provenance: Saved Perfetto MCP SQL and returned results from the current investigation.
purpose: Cross-check MTP compiled-graph ownership, selected gradient-producer correlations, and communication-stream availability.
coverage_limit: The importer omits 58 of 8781 native kernel events. Complete MTP kernel sequences and interval unions use the native trace evidence; imported selected events and collective timestamps are cross-checks.

queries.label: mtp_autograd_invocations
queries.sql: SELECT s.id,s.name,(s.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 host_start_ms,s.dur/1e6 host_duration_ms FROM thread_slice s WHERE s.name='autograd::engine::evaluate_function: CompiledFunctionBackward' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendant_slice(s.id) d WHERE d.name='GFSDP::pre_backward (mtp.layers.0)') ORDER BY s.ts;

queries.label: first_mtp_gemm_shape_metadata
queries.sql: WITH k AS(SELECT DISTINCT d.id,d.host_id,d.arg_set_id FROM rs14_link d JOIN ancestor_slice(d.host_id) a WHERE a.id=7263 AND (d.name GLOB '*nvjet*' OR d.name GLOB '*gemm*' OR d.name GLOB '*sdpa*')) SELECT DISTINCT a.key FROM k JOIN args a ON a.arg_set_id=k.arg_set_id ORDER BY a.key;

queries.label: all_mtp_graph_and_collective_links
queries.sql: SELECT s.id engine_id,c.id graph_id,c.name graph_name,(s.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 host_start_ms,MIN((d.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6) gpu_start_ms,MAX((d.ts+d.dur-3762433098211544)/1e6) gpu_end_ms,COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) imported_device_events FROM thread_slice s JOIN descendant_slice(s.id) c ON c.name='CompiledFunctionBackward' JOIN rs14_link d JOIN ancestor_slice(d.host_id) a ON a.id=c.id WHERE s.id IN (7231,28579,50211) AND d.stream=7 GROUP BY s.id,c.id,c.name ORDER BY s.ts;

queries.label: communication_queue_during_mtp
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT id,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 start_ms,(ts+dur-3762433098211544)/1e6 end_ms,dur/1e6 duration_ms,category,name,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') input_elements,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.Seq') collective_sequence FROM rs14_link WHERE stream=24 AND ((ts BETWEEN 3762433278211544 AND 3762433311211544) OR(ts BETWEEN 3762433698211544 AND 3762433738211544) OR(ts BETWEEN 3762434118211544 AND 3762434158211544)) ORDER BY ts;
